Account background: mid-stage adtech DSP focusing on per-request personalization and reranking for auction-time creative selection. Heavy bursty traffic around campaign launches. Previously on multi-tenant hosted API; exploring Dedicated to hit stricter SLOs and predictable cost.

Recent history / timeline: 
- 2026-01-18: Initial inbound via website form (high QPS, SLA tags). AE assigned (Maya).
- 2026-01-28: Discovery call — product and infra overview. Customer wants reserved capacity + fallbacks.
- 2026-02-10: Pre-workshop questionnaire received: baseline traffic sample (7 days), token histograms, p95 latency goals.
- 2026-02-24: 3-hour sizing workshop with SE (Ethan) + infra; live load trace review (FF link). Covered baseline vs peak planning.
- 2026-02-28: Redwood internal follow-up: proposed config v1 (6x A100 equiv nodes, hot KV cache, autoscale buffer 20%).
- 2026-03-04: Customer asks for breakdown by workload (rerank vs embedding) and cost per qps at different quantization levels.
- 2026-03-08: Legal asks for sample SLA language; customer requests EU data residency for subset of requests.

Sizing workshop highlights (notes / fragments):
- Baseline QPS: 250 sustained requests/sec (all endpoints combined) — typical daytime steady-state.
- Peak QPS: 1,800 req/sec for 8-12 minute spikes during campaign launches (traffic correlated with scheduled sends).
- Avg tokens/request: 120 tokens (reranking payload ~40 tokens, personalization + context ~80 tokens).
- Token/sec baseline: ~30k tokens/sec sustained; peak token/sec observed ~216k tokens/sec.
- Latency targets: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 200ms for critical rerank path; embeddings can be tolerant to p95 < 500ms.
- Throughput SLO ask: guaranteed minimum throughput at 90% of peak for campaign windows (customer requires predictable capacity for auctions).
- KV/prefix caching will dramatically lower steady-state cost for repeated contexts; caching strategy required in deployment plan.
- Recommended reserved GPU planning: start with 8x high-memory GPUs for shard/replication (covers steady-state + 30% headroom), add 2x burst nodes for peak (burst nodes on elastic pool or on-call capacity).
- Batching policy: small continuous batching for rerank path (max latency 50ms) vs larger batch windows for embeddings. Need per-route batching config.
- Fallback policy: route to smaller quantized variant when latency SLO at risk; customer wants explicit fallback in SLA.

Security / compliance notes:
- Must support SAML SSO and SCIM for team provisioning.
- EU residency: want logs and storage for EU customers kept in eu region; audit logs retention 1 year.
- KMS integration required for keys at rest.

Commercial / SLA negotiation items:
- Customer prefers 12-month reserved commit with monthly true-up.
- Wants a 99.9% uptime SLA for critical endpoints; negotiating p95 latency commitments tied to credit structure.
- Pricing ask: flat committed monthly fee covering base reserved capacity + per-token overage rate for peaks.

Quotes / paraphrase from calls: 
- "We need predictable auctions — when traffic spikes, even a few hundred ms of tail latency loses impressions and revenue."
- "If Dedicated can guarantee throughput during campaign windows, we can move to a 12-month commit."
